notes: Fee rule (#59): longest standard outside-UK option is 'more than 3 years - £1,618'; the visa can last up to 5 years, so IHS £1,035 x 5.
processingDaysMin: the page only says 'within 3 weeks' (outside the UK), so any minimum from 0 to 21 days is consistent with it.
applicationUrlHost is the host of the 'Start now' button on the apply-from-outside-the-uk part (an href; the extractor only sees text, so this is expected to be hard to get).

name.source: A Skilled Worker visa allows you to come to or stay in the UK to do an eligible job with an approved employer.

category.source: A Skilled Worker visa allows you to come to or stay in the UK to do an eligible job with an approved employer.

processingDaysMin.source: you’ll usually get a decision within 3 weeks.

processingDaysMax.source: you’ll usually get a decision within 3 weeks.

validityPeriod.source: Your visa can last for up to 5 years before you need to extend it.

isExtendable.source: You can apply to extend your visa as many times as you like as long as you still meet the eligibility requirements.

themes.theme: work for a Home Office approved UK employer
themes.source: work for a UK employer that’s been approved by the Home Office
have a ‘certificate of sponsorship’ (CoS) from your employer with information about the role you’ve been offered in the UK
do a job that’s on the list of eligible occupations
be paid a minimum salary - how much depends on the type of work you do and the date you got your CoS
You must be able to speak, read, write and understand English.

components.source: pay the healthcare surcharge - this is usually £1,035 per year
